blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — A collection of old Philippine coins and banknotes that illustrate the country’s monetary history went on display here Monday (October 5) as the Oriental Mindoro Heritage Museum opened a special exhibition for Museums and Galleries Month. The exhibit features Philippine currency from different periods, inviting visitors to look beyond the monetary value of coins and banknotes and examine how the designs, symbols and images used in them reflect chapters of the country’s history. A 9 a.m. ribbon-cutting ceremony formally opened “Salapi: The History of Philippine Money,” featuring the collection of Pinoy Museum on Wheels (PMOW), which […]...
